label: Everett police incidents (calls for service) from City of Everett Open Data, as of 2026-11-24. 90-day snapshot 2026-08-27 to 2026-11-24. Not a real-time feed. Data: City of Everett / SNO911.
defaultWindowNote: Everett’s default is this 90-day snapshot (2026-08-27 to 2026-11-24). Time presets are measured from the as-of date, not from today. This is the official Police Incidents (calls for service) feed, not Police Cases. Only incident types that match a crime layer are shown. Traffic stops, welfare checks, alarms, and similar CAD activity are omitted. Child-protective and abuse-of-person calls are held off the map. Data: City of Everett / SNO911.
locationPrecision: Official coordinates are already blurred to the 100-block. CrimeStat does not display or store street addresses. The outline is the official incorporated city limit.
cadence: daily in the official Everett feed; this snapshot is not live
